draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.24, the 78th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 4th of 15 at TE. He went 50th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (78th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 590 receiving yards in 2024, 6th of 15 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Seattle Seahawks. 13 career games and 4 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 2 AV in 2025. Versus the typical Year-1 tight end who played: 179 receiving yards against a median of 158, above the norm.
